prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: GPT-3 API Developer for Generating Blog Posts & Promotional Twitter Threads
We are seeking a skilled programmer to help us use GPT-3 based API to programmatically generate blog posts and promotional tweets based on a specific topic or theme. The goal of this project is to fine-tune the GPT-3 model to the specific style and tone of the brand based on set of themes and topics covered by the project. As a GPT-3 API Programmer, you will: - Work with our team to create a GPT-3 based API for generating blog posts and tweets based on a specific topic or theme - Use OpenAI's API to fine-tune the GPT-3 model to the specific style and tone of the brand. - Test and debug the generated blog posts and tweets - Work with our team to ensure that the blog posts and tweets align with the brand's tone and messaging - Implement a review process for the generated blog posts and tweets, where the content is sent to a designated team member or group for review before posting, using tools such as scheduling tools or automation tools such as Zapier - Create the blog post based on a topic or article title, then after approval, create the promotional Twitter thread to drive traffic to the article. Qualifications: - Strong experience with GPT-3 based API, OpenAI's API, and programming languages such as Python or JavaScript - Experience working with APIs and integrating them with other systems - Strong understanding of natural language processing and machine learning - Strong understanding of Twitter API and its integration - Strong problem-solving and debugging skills - Strong
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a reliable way to generate brand-aligned blog posts and promotional Twitter threads from a topic or article title, with a clear review step before anything is published.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be glad to help build this workflow using Python and OpenAI’s API. I have 6 years of experience working in machine learning and NLP, and I regularly work with tools and libraries such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and the OpenAI API. For a project like this, I’d focus on creating a clean generation pipeline that can take a topic, produce a draft blog post in the desired brand voice, and then generate a Twitter thread only after approval.

I can help structure the solution so it is practical and easy to maintain: prompt design for consistent tone, API integration for content generation, and a review step that routes drafts to the right person or group before the next stage begins. I would also make sure the system is testable and debuggable, so you can evaluate the output quality and refine the prompts or fine-tuning approach as needed.

Since you want the content to match a specific style and messaging, I’d pay close attention to how the model is guided with themes, tone constraints, and formatting requirements. I can also help think through how to connect the generation flow with scheduling or automation tools such as Zapier, so the process is efficient without losing editorial control.

I’m comfortable working on the machine learning and NLP side as well as the API integration side, so I can support both the content quality and the technical implementation. If you already have examples of the brand voice or approved posts, those would be useful for shaping the generation behavior.

What review and approval flow do you want between the blog post draft and the Twitter thread generation?
